BiblicalUsage: Malats means to be smooth, pleasant, sweet, and it appears once, in Psalms 119:103, where the psalmist says, how sweet are Thy words unto my taste, yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this one verse is the whole reason to read the Bible: His words are sweet because they are true.
